method: Retrospective replay through the current Path to Win calculation, sampled about every five minutes of game-event time. Never a record of what the site displayed.
limitations: Today's public picks/tiebreaker guesses are held fixed throughout; their original submission/edit times were not recorded.

Pregame probabilities use the spread curve on genuine ESPN summary quotes saved October20, not the unavailable historical scoreboard odds feed. Those fixed pregame quotes are used until each kickoff; later pregame line movement is not modeled.

ESPN home-win probabilities are joined to retained play wallclock timestamps. Unmatched plays are omitted. The last matched value is held without a staleness cutoff until another matched play or the final event, so missing interior updates may appear flat instead of a gap. Nulls mark the interval before the first matched live value.
Game completion is placed at the retained End of Game play or final-period0:00 play; overtime may end before0:00. Delays for reviews/corrections are not reproduced.
This current calculation may differ from the site's historical implementation. Equal unresolved ties use existing shared credit; no tiebreaker-total forecast was added.
Game-level probabilities are ESPN estimates; the retrospective pool curve is not verified prediction accuracy or an independently validated historical win forecast.
